title: Geekvape Q Replacement Pods - 3 Pack
description: The Geek Vape Sonder Q vape kit is a sleek and sophisticated yet simple to use and highly portable vape device that’s ideal for beginners, or any vaper who just wants a discreet, convenient and stylish pod kit to carry with them. The Top-Filling Geekvape Q refillable 2ml pods incorporate your choice of fixed 0.6ohm, 0.8ohm or 1.2ohm coils, and the newer, side-filling 0.4ohm pod - ideal for RDL vaping - all allow for a wide range of vaping styles. When your pod loses its flavour, you simply replace it with a new refillable Q pod. The 2ml pod features a leak-resistant silicone seal on the side for easy refills, and is best used with nic salt , 50/50 and classic High-PG e-liquids. Compatible with Geek Vape Sonder Q and Geekvape Wenax Q Pod Kit Pod Details: 0.4ohm Side-Fill pods use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid Only 0.6ohm Top-Fill pods use Nic Salts or 50/50 E-Liquids 0.8ohm Top-Fill pods use 50/50, Nic Salts E-Liquids 1.2ohm Top-Fill pods use 50/50 or High PG E-Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
